newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH SHELL CUTS RECOMMANDED DIESEL PRICE.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH SHELL CUTS RECOMMANDED DIESEL PRICE.

text.p: Royal Dutch/Shell unit Shell Nederland BV said it will cut its retail price for diesel in the Netherlands to 1.478 per litre from 1.488 with effect from February 21.
The move reflects changes in international product prices the company said, adding the other gasoline prices would remain unchanged.
The price of premium unleaded gasoline at Shell's self-service stations will remain unchanged at 2.11 guilders per litre.
The price of premium with lead substitute will remain unchanged at 2.18, and that of Euro regular unleaded stays at 2.06 guilders.
